bank_name: South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: Year-end (31 December 2025) position, SOLO basis, primarily from the bank's own audited Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss Account and the 'Highlights on the overall activities of the bank' annexure in that year's own annual report. AUDITOR ISSUED A QUALIFIED OPINION for FY2025 (first in this bank's history in this archive). Emphasis-of-matter figures (all directly quoted from the Independent Auditor's Report as reproduced in the Directors' Report): required provision Tk.1,379.40 crore (13,794.0m) vs provision maintained Tk.355.83 crore (3,558.3m) = a provision shortfall of Tk.1,023.57 crore (10,235.7m) -- equal to 91.6% of total shareholders' equity (11,174,656,661). Within this, Tk.158.66 crore relates to fixed deposits placed with NBFIs that matured long ago and are doubtful of recovery, against which the Bank held ZERO provision. Required capital was Tk.1,135.00 crore (11,350.0m) against total eligible (Solo) capital of Tk.1,216.84 crore (12,168.4m, matching this dataset's total_capital below), a reported surplus of Tk.81.84 crore (818.4m); the auditors state that had the full provision shortfall been recognised, CRAR would have fallen below the 12.50% regulatory minimum (reported CRAR was 13.40%). Classified loans/NPL ratio (19.87%, 18,814.94m classified) are Consolidated-basis figures (the only basis found in extractable text); given the subsidiary does not lend, this is treated as a close proxy for Solo. Provision coverage of classified loans fell to 12.60% (2,371.25m held / 18,814.94m classified) from 30.2% in FY2024, i.e. the bank REDUCED provisioning in absolute terms even as classified loans grew 31%. Bangladesh Bank directed no dividend be paid for FY2025 (letter BSD-5/106/2026-403), and the resulting consecutive non-dividend years triggered a technical 'Z-Category' reclassification on the exchange. Interest income (8,565,552,982) is calculated as net interest income plus interest paid (both reported); the interest-income row itself is blank in the extracted P&L, and is corroborated by the (Consolidated) 5-year table's Total Interest Income of 8,607.26m for FY2025. FY2024 comparative column in this report differs slightly from FY2024's own report -- see the FY2024 record's period_note for the reconciliation. Total Capital, CRAR and Required Capital are all directly quoted in the Independent Auditor's Emphasis of Matter and are mutually exactly consistent (12,168.4-11,350.0=818.4=reported surplus; 12,168.4/90,800.36=13.40%=reported CRAR). Tier-I/Tier-II split specific to Solo not found in extractable text (only a Consolidated-basis CET1=12.07%-of-13.37%-total figure elsewhere); left as a gap.
